correctness.rationale: PASS. Re-derived affine square coordinates with four side-selection masses u,v,u,v (arclength matters), where u+v=1/2. Exhaustive occupancy weights for three distinct, two opposed, two adjacent and three coincident sides are 6uv,6(u^3+v^3),6uv,2(u^3+v^3). The distinct-side deficit W=x(1-y)+yz gives a piecewise truncated triangle integral F(eps); opposite sides give eps^2; adjacent give J(eps). Algebra gives the claimed .75 eps^2+6uv H(eps) for each 0<eps<.5, with positive H series starting eps^2 log and strictly positive k>=4 coefficients. The maximum is S/2 and rhombi maximize uv. For y in [eps,1-eps], change X=x(1-y)/eps,Z=yz/eps has an exact simplex Jacobian eps^2/[y(1-y)]; normalized simplex Dirichlet(1,1,1) and logarithmic y-density imply joint total-variation mark convergence; outside mass O(eps^2) vs leading eps^2 log. Independent direct numerical analytic integrals/mixture algebra at eps=.03,.1,.2,.49 agree. Angle independence and fixed-positive-sides caveat observed.
